INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ROLE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{loginId}, #{loginPw}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role})

SELECT MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, M.CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, P.POINT, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(M.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPONHISTORY H WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = H.MEMBER_ID AND H.TYPE='ISSUE') AS ISSUE FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERPOINT P ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_VALUE, C.COUPON_TEXT, C.CREATED_AT, C.DEADLINE, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(C.DEADLINE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEAD_LINE_STR FROM COUPONHISTORY H JOIN COUPON C ON H.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE H.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND H.TYPE='ISSUE'

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME, I.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH FROM WISH W JOIN PRODUCT P ON W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE I ON P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID WHERE W.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND I.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0

SELECT C.CART_ID, C.QTY, O.OPTION_NAME, O.OPTION_PRICE, O.OPTION_STOCK, P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, I.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH FROM CART C JOIN OPTIONDETAIL D ON C.POP_ID = D.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION O ON D.OPTION_ID = O.OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON D.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE I ON D.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND I.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0
